![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

To prevent false negatives where malformed or missing node/edge IDs (which resolve to `null` or `undefined`) incorrectly match each other in the `Set`, filter out non-string or empty IDs when constructing `paperSources` and `sourceDocumentSources`.

```suggestion
  const paperSources = new Set(edges
    .filter((edge) => edge?.edge_family === 'question_belongs_to_paper')
    .map((edge) => edge?.from_node_id)
    .filter((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0));
  const sourceDocumentSources = new Set(edges
    .filter((edge) => edge?.edge_family === 'question_derived_from_source_document')
    .map((edge) => edge?.from_node_id)
    .filter((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0));
```
